cells.gaps: No source since October 2023 names two education systems exchanging data or using one learner identifier. The ministry's GREEN guide gives every pupil a national education identifier (IEN) but names no second system that uses it.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-11-03 (messages-for-bill 68: question 3 needs a source naming two systems that use the identifier): the GREEN guide names only GREEN, so nothing places the cell.
